classificationPolicy: Availability, interpretation and normative preference are independent. No confirmed CHEMICAL_ERROR or newly adjudicated NOMENCLATURE_ERROR. AUD009-005 retains UNVERIFIED normative status.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.evidenceBoundary: La captura PNG conserva contexto inglés y la molécula, pero no muestra el texto del error dentro del viewport. El mensaje consta en S38 de la matriz y la observación automatizada original resumida en browser-checks.json; no se creó una nueva captura en 009B.
findings.title: El rechazo isotópico aparece en español en /en/
findings.observed: La estructura contiene isótopos explícitos que el editor todavía no admite. No se importó para evitar alterar su identidad química.
findings.impact: An English-speaking student cannot read why a safe import was rejected.
findings.recommendation: Localizar el mensaje por identidad de error en ES/EN y conservar el rechazo seguro.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: Falta cobertura Legacy ES para familias sencillas dentro del dominio general
findings.observed: 18/38 imported molecules named in 1979-es; 20 blocked. Four are deliberate substituted-aryl scope gates; 16 other outputs are missing coverage.
findings.impact: A learner may assume the historical profile covers the same families as the modern profile.
findings.recommendation: Publicar una tabla de cobertura por idioma/perfil. Ampliar solo con adjudicación y regresiones propias; no copiar 2013 por defecto.
findings.costNote: Documentar la cobertura cuesta poco; ampliar familias requiere trabajo y adjudicación separados.
findings.novelty: Existing limitation, re-observed. Not a regression of AUD-NOM-007.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: La pérdida de sesión al recargar se explica en README pero no junto al inicio de la actividad
steps: Start a one-question activity or two-question exam
Inspect setup, question and results text
findings.observed: No reload/session-temporariness warning in the captured setup/question/results. README states that sessions, drafts, attempts and Dashboard end on reload.
findings.impact: Users can expect durable results from Dashboard or confuse in-session drafts with saved drafts.
findings.recommendation: Aviso breve y bilingüe junto a Start: resultados y borradores solo durante esta sesión; recargar los pierde. Mantener separada la persistencia de la biblioteca.
findings.novelty: Known persistence design; finding concerns current communication, not missing remote storage.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: Recargar un nombre local con sustituyente entre paréntesis elimina sus enlaces pedagógicos
steps: Import c1(CCO)c(C)cccc1 in current English profile
Observe the same name/formula with no name links
findings.observed: Before reload, aryl/ethan/1-ol links exist. After reload the name is plain text; only external links remain.
findings.impact: A supported educational explanation loses interactive access after returning to the lab.
findings.recommendation: Distinguir nombres externos preservados de nombres locales recalculables; reactivar evidencia solo cuando nombre, grafo y perfil coincidan exactamente. Conservar el bloqueo para fuentes ajenas.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.evidenceBoundary: CONFIRMED se refiere al texto observado y al rechazo del parser guardado. La corrección normativa histórica permanece UNVERIFIED; no es un error químico confirmado.
findings.title: Dos salidas Legacy EN siguen mezclando morfología española
steps: Read exact 1979-en names and original exact-text OPSIN receipts
findings.observed: 1-chloro-4-vinilbenzene; 2-pentoxiheptane. Exact stored OPSIN responses reject both.
findings.impact: The English historical profile presents uncertain lexical forms as available.
findings.recommendation: Adjudicar el texto histórico inglés antes de corregirlo o habilitar otra forma; comunicar incertidumbre. No copiar automáticamente los nombres modernos.
findings.novelty: Known residual Legacy issue documented in AUD-NOM-006; not a reopened modern regression.
findings.certainty: HIGH that the exact mixed-language texts are current and parser-rejected; UNVERIFIED normative historical spelling and no proven chemical mismatch.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: Falta una entrada pública breve en inglés a límites, privacidad y reporte de errores
steps: Inspect English main UI links and help
findings.observed: Product and privacy documentation is primarily Spanish; English sections describe the Sites scaffold. Main UI exposes Instagram and chemical sources, but no observed direct bug-report/privacy/scope-documentation entry.
findings.impact: International visitors cannot readily find scope differences, temporary sessions, third-party services or a useful bug-report channel.
findings.recommendation: Añadir introducción breve en inglés con enlace /en/, límites por perfil, sesiones locales/temporales, terceros y GitHub Issues. Enlazar esa información desde la aplicación. No afirmar open source sin licencia explícita.
findings.privacyLimit: Analytics script is unconditional in HTML. Compound-context resolver can run when a name/identity is visible; do not describe all third-party access as manually initiated. No consent-law adjudication performed.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: Al recuperar History queda visible la confirmación SMILES de otra molécula
steps: Open History and load the pre-existing ethanol entry
findings.observed: Canvas/formula/name show ethanol C2H6O, but panel still says 'SMILES imported with OpenChemLib. Suggested IUPAC name: butane.'
findings.impact: Two conflicting chemical identities appear in one screen although the graph and active name are correct.
findings.recommendation: Invalidar el feedback de importación al restaurar o cambiar la molécula, o asociarlo a la identidad exacta de la importación.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: Escape atiende el panel de fondo antes que el diálogo Settings
findings.observed: Settings stays open. Global shortcut branch clears SMILES/tool panels before testing settingsOpen.
findings.impact: Keyboard dismissal requires a second Escape when a background panel is open; foreground overlay behavior is inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Dar prioridad al overlay activo al resolver Escape. Mantener foco y restauración al disparador.
findings.scope: Localized usability issue: labeled Close button remains available. Not a claim of complete keyboard or screen-reader failure.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: README sigue encabezado Hydrocarbon Lab mientras la aplicación se llama OrgoRush
steps: Compare README headings with live browser title/H1
findings.observed: README: Hydrocarbon Lab / Laboratorio de Hidrocarburos; live title/H1: OrgoRush.
findings.impact: Visitors may not immediately recognize the repository as the same product.
findings.recommendation: Alinear el encabezado y explicar que Hydrocarbon-Lab sigue siendo la ruta del repositorio; no requiere cambiar URLs ni arquitectura.

findings.reproducibility: Reproducible in the cited current UI snapshot or fixed engine sample
findings.title: El texto de alcance aún dice nueve familias funcionales
steps: Compare with current Practice category list
findings.observed: Footer says nine functional-group families; current categories include alcohol, aldehyde, ketone, acid, ether, ester, amine, amide, nitrile and nitro, plus halogenated compounds.
findings.impact: A fixed count obscures the current coverage and differences between tools/profiles.
findings.recommendation: Usar una enumeración o enlace de alcance mantenido y distinguir categorías de ejercicio de soporte de nomenclatura.
